latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Change Face — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered face swapping for video clips, supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Lets users upload a video, describe face replacement requests, and download the 1080p MP4 result in 1–2 minutes.
- Requires a token-based cloud session; automatically handles token generation for new users.
- Includes workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, credits checking, and exporting videos.
- Provides a streamlined chat interface tailored for content creators needing quick, high-quality face swaps.
